hook: Brad Smith leads Microsoft's legal and public policy operation and functions as the company's principal voice in Washington and other capitals on AI regulation, export controls, and the build-out of sovereign compute capacity.
name: Brad Smith

quote.text: Datacenters require a vast supply chain, and the country that builds the fastest and most reliable supply chain will lead in AI.
quote.context: Brad Smith, Senate Commerce Committee testimony, May 8, 2025

moniker: Vice Chair and President of Microsoft

primary.name: Microsoft Executive Officers: Brad Smith, official bio
Brad Smith, Winning the AI Race, Microsoft On the Issues, May 8, 2025

secondary.name: Microsoft CLO Brad Smith Appointed Vice Chair, Law360
Microsoft makes top lawyer Brad Smith its vice chair, CNBC

timeline.event: Joins Microsoft, initially leading legal and corporate affairs for Europe from Paris
timeline.impact: Begins a three-decade career inside Microsoft's legal and policy functions
Takes charge of Microsoft's legal strategy, including its antitrust matters

timeline.event: Promoted to President of Microsoft while retaining the chief legal officer title
timeline.impact: Expands his remit to include corporate affairs and public policy company-wide

timeline.event: Appointed Vice Chair of Microsoft, continuing as President
timeline.impact: Formalizes his role as Microsoft's senior public-facing voice on technology policy

timeline.event: Testifies before the US Senate Commerce Committee on AI infrastructure and export control policy
timeline.impact: Argues for expanded US electrical grid and workforce capacity and against blanket GPU export restrictions on allied nations

quick_facts: Vice Chair and President of Microsoft, appointed Vice Chair on September 15, 2021 while continuing as President
Served as Microsoft General Counsel from 2002 to 2015 before being named President
Oversees Microsoft's business, legal and corporate affairs organization across more than 120 countries
Testified before the US Senate Commerce Committee on AI infrastructure and export control policy on May 8, 2025
Publishes regularly on Microsoft On the Issues on AI regulation, cybersecurity and export policy

achievements.title: Vice Chair and President, Microsoft
achievements.impact: Leads Microsoft's roughly 2,000-person legal, corporate affairs and public policy organization and represents the company on AI regulation, cybersecurity, privacy and sustainability policy before governments worldwide.

achievements.title: Senate Commerce Committee testimony on AI infrastructure, May 2025
achievements.impact: Set out a three-part US AI competitiveness agenda covering electrical grid capacity, workforce diffusion, and export control policy, arguing against blanket GPU export caps on allied nations.

achievements.title: Microsoft General Counsel, 2002 to 2015
achievements.impact: Led Microsoft's legal function through a decade that included resolution of the company's antitrust disputes with US and European regulators.
